description: Test suite for the StorageProvider's execution webhook management functionalities, including registration, retrieval, status updates, and concurrency handling, focusing on the internal storage implementation within the control-plane component.

methods.name: setupTestStorage
methods.description: Sets up a test instance of the StorageProvider with local storage configuration, ensuring cleanup procedures and database initialization before tests run.

methods.name: TestRegisterExecutionWebhook_Success
methods.description: Verifies successful registration and retrieval of an execution webhook with all fields correctly stored.

methods.name: TestRegisterExecutionWebhook_NilWebhook
methods.description: Checks that passing a nil webhook results in an error.

methods.name: TestRegisterExecutionWebhook_EmptyExecutionID
methods.description: Ensures that registering a webhook with an empty execution ID produces an error.

methods.name: TestRegisterExecutionWebhook_EmptyURL
methods.description: Ensures that registering a webhook with an empty URL produces an error.

methods.name: TestRegisterExecutionWebhook_NoSecret
methods.description: Verifies that registration works without a secret, and secret remains nil.

methods.name: TestRegisterExecutionWebhook_NoHeaders
methods.description: Verifies that registration works with nil headers, resulting in an empty headers map.

methods.name: TestRegisterExecutionWebhook_UpdateExisting
methods.description: Tests updating an existing webhook entry, verifying new data overwrites previous.

methods.name: TestGetExecutionWebhook_NotFound
methods.description: Ensures retrieving a non-existent webhook returns nil without error.

methods.name: TestListDueExecutionWebhooks_Empty
methods.description: Checks that listing due webhooks returns empty when none are pending.

methods.name: TestListDueExecutionWebhooks_DueNow
methods.description: Verifies that webhooks due at current time are listed.

methods.name: TestListDueExecutionWebhooks_NotDueYet
methods.description: Ensures webhooks not yet due are not included in the list.

methods.name: TestListDueExecutionWebhooks_OnlyPending
methods.description: Confirms only pending webhooks are listed, excluding others by status.

methods.name: TestListDueExecutionWebhooks_Limit
methods.description: Checks that limit parameter caps the number of webhooks returned.

methods.name: TestListDueExecutionWebhooks_DefaultLimit
methods.description: Tests default behavior when limit is set to zero, expecting all due webhooks.

methods.name: TestTryMarkExecutionWebhookInFlight_Success
methods.description: Verifies successful transition of webhook status to 'delivering' if eligible.

methods.name: TestTryMarkExecutionWebhookInFlight_AlreadyDelivering
methods.description: Ensures that webhooks already in 'delivering' status are not marked again.

methods.name: TestTryMarkExecutionWebhookInFlight_NotDueYet
methods.description: Checks that webhooks not yet due are not marked as in flight.

methods.name: TestUpdateExecutionWebhookState_Success
methods.description: Tests updating webhook state with new status, attempt counts, and timestamps.

methods.name: TestUpdateExecutionWebhookState_ClearError
methods.description: Verifies behavior when clearing last error during state update.

methods.name: TestHasExecutionWebhook_True
methods.description: Confirms Presence check returns true for existing webhooks.

methods.name: TestHasExecutionWebhook_False
methods.description: Checks that Presence check returns false for non-existing webhooks.

methods.name: TestListExecutionWebhooksRegistered_Empty
methods.description: Validates that an empty input list yields empty registration results.

methods.name: TestListExecutionWebhooksRegistered_SomeRegistered
methods.description: Verifies registration status across multiple execution IDs.

methods.name: TestListExecutionWebhooksRegistered_Deduplication
methods.description: Tests that duplicate IDs are correctly handled and deduplicated.

methods.name: TestListExecutionWebhooksRegistered_EmptyStrings
methods.description: Ensures that empty or whitespace strings in the list do not produce errors nor false positives.

methods.name: TestExecutionWebhooks_ConcurrentMarkInFlight
methods.description: Simulates concurrent attempts to mark a webhook as in-flight, asserting only one succeeds.
